description: This file contains the implementation of a simple in-memory Least Recently Used (LRU) cache with a specified maximum number of cached entries. It manages cache items using PHP's ordered associative array, reordering accessed elements to implement the LRU policy, and removes least recently used items when the cache exceeds its limit.

classes.name: LruArrayCache
classes.description: A class implementing a simple in-memory LRU cache using PHP's associative array, supporting cache retrieval, insertion, removal, and count operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new LruArrayCache with an optional maximum number of items.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an item from the cache, updating its position to reflect recent use; returns null if not found or expired.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds or updates an item in the cache, removing least recently used items if exceeding the maximum allowed.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the cache by key.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of items currently stored in the cache.
